en: The postcard is a sepia-toned view depicting a large neoclassical building with many columns and a symmetrical façade. A winding pathway leads up to the impressive structure, which is likely an institutional or government building. There is Greek and French text, as well as handwritten notes. A postage stamp with 'ΕΛΛΑΣ' (Hellas/Greece) and the numerical value of 5 ΛΕΠΤΑ can be seen. The date written appears to be 1903.
